name: Establishment of the United States Space Force
effect: Recommends the formation of a United States Space Command to control our space forces and develop the tactics, techniques, and procedures for military space operations; establishment of the Space Force as a separate and distinct branch of the military whose mission will be to organize, train, and equip combat space forces; joint review by the National Space Council and National Security Council of existing space operational authorities for meeting national security objectives, informed by DOD's assessment of the authorities required; creation of a Space Development Agency to ensure Americans in the Space Force have cutting-edge warfighting capabilities; and creation of collaborative mechanisms with the Intelligence Community to improve unity of efforts for the development of space capabilities and operations.
alignment_notes: Recommends more government oversight in space but not for safety/sustainability reasons - the command instead focuses on military space operations.
sponsors: Scott Pace (Deputy Assistant to the President & Executive Secretary of the National Space Council)
